supporting_observations.claim: At 13:50:07 UTC, C:\Program Files\Cloudkeep\agent.exe ran on FILE-BLU-01 as BLUEFIN\svc-arch with a Nightly job targeting ingest.cloudkeep-backup.com.

The same agent process connected to the explicit proxy, and the proxy recorded a successful transfer to ingest.cloudkeep-backup.com with 640,000,000 client-to-server bytes. Zeek independently recorded 640,000,483 client-originated bytes on the associated proxy connection.

The destination, executable path, service account, and several-hundred-megabyte transfer size match the organization’s listed Cloudkeep backup service and expected upload behavior; the evidence supports treating the alerted transfer as the approved backup activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The network records show the destination and byte counts, but do not reveal the contents of the encrypted backup transfer.
The outbound transfer is recorded at 13:50 UTC, several minutes after the alert's approximate 13:46 UTC time; the evidence does not establish the alert's exact trigger timestamp.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish which files or data were included in the backup.
The evidence does not independently verify that the remote service retained or successfully processed the uploaded data.
unrelated_findings: At 13:54 UTC, FILE-BLU-01 attempted a proxy connection to downloads.cloud.com using a curl user agent; the proxy denied it. This is outside the alerted transfer and should be reviewed separately if warranted. (T220-00349, T220-00350)

At 14:11 UTC, PROXY-BLU-01 made an SMB connection attempt to FILE-BLU-01 using the disabled account svc_mgmt; authentication failed. This is unrelated to the alerted transfer and should be handled separately. (T220-00469, T220-00470)
